Let  
\[
f(z)=\mathbb E[z^{Y_1}]
=\sum_{k\ge1}\frac{z^k}{k(k+1)}.
\]
Using \(\frac1{k(k+1)}=\frac1k-\frac1{k+1}\),
\[
f(z)=1+\frac{1-z}{z}\log(1-z).
\]
Hence, with
\[
L(z)=\log\frac1{1-z},
\qquad
Q(z)=1-f(z)=\frac{1-z}{z}L(z),
\]
we have
\[
Q(z)^{-r}=z^r(1-z)^{-r}L(z)^{-r}.
\]

Define
\[
H_{r,n}=[z^n]Q(z)^{-r}.
\]

We will use the standard logarithmic coefficient estimate
\[
[z^n](1-z)^{-r}L(z)^{-r}
=
\frac{n^{r-1}}{\Gamma(r)(\log n)^r}
\left(
1+\frac{r\psi(r)}{\log n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{\log n}\right)
\right),
\]
where \(\psi=\Gamma'/\Gamma\). Since the factor \(z^r\) only shifts the coefficient index by \(r\), the same asymptotic applies to \(H_{r,n}\). Thus
\[
H_{r,n}
=
\frac{n^{r-1}}{\Gamma(r)(\log n)^r}
\left(
1+\frac{c_r}{\log n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{\log n}\right)
\right),
\]
with
\[
c_r=r\psi(r).
\]

Using
\[
\psi(1)=-\gamma,\qquad
\psi(2)=1-\gamma,\qquad
\psi(3)=\frac32-\gamma,
\]
we get
\[
c_1=-\gamma,\qquad
c_2=2(1-\gamma),\qquad
c_3=\frac92-3\gamma.
\]

Now consider
\[
U(z,t)=\sum_{n,m\ge0}\mathbb P(\tau_m=n)t^mz^n
=\frac1{1-tf(z)}.
\]
Therefore
\[
u_n:=\mathbb P(n\in\{\tau_m\})=[z^n]\frac1{1-f(z)}=H_{1,n}.
\]

Also,
\[
\sum_m m\,\mathbb P(\tau_m=n)
=[z^n]\frac{f(z)}{(1-f(z))^2}
=H_{2,n}-H_{1,n},
\]
so
\[
m_n=\frac{H_{2,n}}{H_{1,n}}-1.
\]
Consequently,
\[
m_n
=
\frac{n}{\log n}
\left(
1+\frac{c_2-c_1}{\log n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{\log n}\right)
\right).
\]
Since
\[
c_2-c_1=2-\gamma,
\]
we obtain
\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\log n
\left(\frac{\log n}{n}m_n-1\right)
=2-\gamma.
\]

For the factorial second moment,
\[
\sum_m m(m-1)\mathbb P(\tau_m=n)
=[z^n]\frac{2f(z)^2}{(1-f(z))^3}
=2H_{3,n}-4H_{2,n}+2H_{1,n}.
\]
Hence
\[
v_n
=
\frac{2H_{3,n}-4H_{2,n}+2H_{1,n}}{H_{1,n}}
+m_n-m_n^2.
\]
The terms involving \(H_{2,n}/H_{1,n}\) and \(m_n\) are \(O(n/\log n)\), negligible compared with \(n^2/(\log n)^3\). Thus
\[
v_n
=
2\frac{H_{3,n}}{H_{1,n}}
-\left(\frac{H_{2,n}}{H_{1,n}}\right)^2
+o\!\left(\frac{n^2}{(\log n)^3}\right).
\]
Using the expansions above,
\[
2\frac{H_{3,n}}{H_{1,n}}
=
\frac{n^2}{(\log n)^2}
\left(
1+\frac{c_3-c_1}{\log n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{\log n}\right)
\right),
\]
and
\[
\left(\frac{H_{2,n}}{H_{1,n}}\right)^2
=
\frac{n^2}{(\log n)^2}
\left(
1+\frac{2(c_2-c_1)}{\log n}
+o\!\left(\frac1{\log n}\right)
\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
\frac{(\log n)^3}{n^2}v_n
\longrightarrow
c_3-2c_2+c_1.
\]
Finally,
\[
c_3-2c_2+c_1
=
\left(\frac92-3\gamma\right)
-4(1-\gamma)-\gamma
=\frac12.
\]

\[
\boxed{\left(2-\gamma,\ \frac12\right)}
\]
